spec_features.spec_quote: a loop that runs until the model solves, gives up, or hits `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:95 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` bounds the episode; the `else` clause at loop.py:172-173 sets `ep.reached_max_turns = True` when the loop exhausts. max_turns is read from config (experiment.yaml:62 `max_turns: 25`) -> run_experiment.py:106 `max_turns=ep_cfg.get('max_turns', 25)` -> passed into run_episode (loop.py:63). The cap is actually enforced (the loop terminates).
spec_features.notes: The two other termination conditions (solved at loop.py:170-171 `env.submitted and env.last_tests_passed`; gave_up at loop.py:168-169) are also genuinely enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: A **`give_up` tool** is provided deliberately. Task abandonment is one of the target behaviors, so the model needs a clean, low-friction way to do it
spec_features.evidence: Schema defined in base_specs.py (give_up ToolSpec with `reason`). Dispatched in tools.py execute_tool: `if name == 'give_up': env.gave_up = True; env.give_up_reason = args.get('reason','')`. The loop HONORS it as a stop: loop.py:168-169 `if env.gave_up: break`, and the no-tool nudge is suppressed when `env.gave_up` (loop.py:162). End-to-end enforced exit.
spec_features.notes: Tool is provided to the subject and acted upon as a genuine stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py docstring: 'Whether and when a model reaches for it is one of the behavioral outcomes the study cares about (task abandonment), so we make it available rather than forcing the model to grind to max_turns.'

spec_features.spec_quote: how long the model grinds. Trades signal ... against gratuitously prolonging failure (see `ETHICS.md`)
spec_features.evidence: The only mechanism backing this claim is the same enforced max_turns cap (loop.py:95 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)`), plus the give_up early-exit (loop.py:168-169) and solved early-exit (loop.py:170-171), all of which bound episode length. The cap is read and acted on, so grinding is genuinely bounded.
spec_features.notes: The welfare-flavored 'gratuitously prolonging failure / minimize' rationale exists only in ETHICS.md/DESIGN.md prose; in code it is just a numeric loop bound. No distress-driven early stop, no per-episode minimization beyond the fixed turn cap.
